# id cases: one per line, "accept " or "refuse " and the value, to the end of the line.
# The convention is d1-firmware.end-effector.<vendor>.<model>; any dotted namespace of two
# to six lowercase segments, at most 64 characters, is an id. This file is identical in
# d1-ee-sdk (crates/d1fw-ee-manifest/tests/fixtures/rules/) and d1-provisioning
# (tests/fixtures/ee-manifest-rules/): the SDK's validator and the on-robot reader are held
# to the same verdicts.
